# Contract: Capability Map Schema

File: `.rewind/capability-map.toml`. Generated by `tools/spine_test.py` after a
live account run. Read at import time by `src/rewind/capabilities.py`. Never
hand-edited. The prose companion `.rewind/daytona-capability-map.md` stays as the
human-readable record.

Traces: FR-000-01, FR-000-01a, FR-000-01b, FR-000-04, FR-000-11, NFR-000-01,
NFR-000-03.

---

## Schema

```toml
# .rewind/capability-map.toml  — GENERATED, do not edit by hand
runtime_version   = "v0.207.0"        # string, required — SDK/API version at generation
generated_at      = "2026-08-29T04:15:00Z"  # ISO-8601, required
account_cpu_total = 10                # int > 0, required — becomes the concurrency ceiling
max_branches      = 3                 # int > 0, ≤ account_cpu_total, required

classes = ["container", "vm"]         # array of string, required, non-empty

[[operation]]
name            = "spawn"             # string, required, non-empty, verbatim runtime name
required_class  = "container"         # string, required, must be in `classes`
post_condition  = "handle.id non-empty; `echo ok` exits 0 before return; auto-stop + auto-delete set"
experimental    = false              # bool, required

[[operation]]
name            = "checkpoint"
required_class  = "container"
post_condition  = "returns snapshot name; branch from it yields children with pre-snapshot filesystem state"
experimental    = false

[[operation]]
name               = "branch"
required_class     = "container"
post_condition     = "returns exactly n handles; each child shows parent pre-snapshot state; children diverge independently"
experimental       = false

# Example of an experimental-flagged entry (not currently present):
# [[operation]]
# name                = "fork"
# required_class       = "vm"
# post_condition       = "child cat /tmp/marker.txt shows parent marker"
# experimental         = true
# experimental_marker  = "_experimental_fork"   # required when experimental = true
```

---

## Field rules

| Field | Type | Required | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runtime_version` | string | yes | Contract test compares against the live SDK/API version; mismatch is a drift failure, not a credentials failure. |
| `generated_at` | ISO-8601 string | yes | Informational; lets a reviewer see how stale the map is. |
| `account_cpu_total` | int > 0 | yes | The Concurrency Ceiling `limit`. The running system MAY lower it via env for a constrained venue, MUST NOT raise it above this value. |
| `max_branches` | int, `0 < x ≤ account_cpu_total` | yes | Upper bound on `n` for `branch`. |
| `classes` | array of string, non-empty | yes | The closed set of `SandboxClass` values. Every `required_class` must appear here. |
| `operation` | array of table, ≥ 1 entry | yes | Empty or missing → `CapabilityError` at import. |
| `operation.name` | string, non-empty, unique | yes | The exact runtime name. Compared by equality; no normalization. |
| `operation.required_class` | string ∈ `classes` | yes | Absent or not in `classes` → incomplete → `CapabilityError`. |
| `operation.post_condition` | string, non-empty | yes | Records the observable effect asserted during generation (FR-000-01a). Absent → incomplete → `CapabilityError`. |
| `operation.experimental` | bool | yes | `true` iff the runtime flags the name experimental. |
| `operation.experimental_marker` | string | iff `experimental = true` | The runtime's own stability tag. Missing when `experimental = true` → incomplete → `CapabilityError` (FR-000-01b). Forbidden when `experimental = false`. |

---

## Generation obligations (`spine_test.py`)

| # | Obligation | Trace |
|---|---|---|
| G1 | An operation is written to the file **only** after the live run asserted its `post_condition` — not on a non-error return alone. | FR-000-01a |
| G2 | `fork` (or any operation that returned an unsupported/error response) is **omitted**, not written with a failing note. | Constitution Art. XIII |
| G3 | `account_cpu_total` and `max_branches` are taken from the observed concurrency run, not from documentation. | FR-000-11, Art. IV |
| G4 | If an operation's verified name carries an experimental marker in the SDK, both `experimental = true` and `experimental_marker` are written. | FR-000-01b |
| G5 | The generator overwrites the whole file atomically; no partial map is ever left on disk. | NFR-000-01 |

---

## Consumer obligations (`capabilities.py`)

| # | Obligation | Trace |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | Load and validate at module import; any failure raises `CapabilityError(ImportError)` before consumer code runs. | FR-000-03, NFR-000-01 |
| P2 | Expose `VERIFIED_OPS: frozenset[str]`, `CLASS_OF: Mapping[str, SandboxClass]`, `CEILING: int`, `MAX_BRANCHES: int`, `EXPERIMENTAL: Mapping[str, str]`. | FR-000-01, FR-000-04 |
| P3 | Provide `assert_declared(ops: Iterable[str])` and `assert_class(op: str, handle)` raising `CapabilityError` with the offending name. | FR-000-03, FR-000-04 |
| P4 | Never write the file, never fabricate an entry for a missing operation. | Art. IV |
